description: This file contains the PHP class EmailConfigurationDao, which provides data access methods for EmailConfiguration entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and saving email configuration data, and extends a base DAO class.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmailConfiguration entities, providing methods to retrieve and save email configuration data.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration from the database, returns null if none exists.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Persists a given EmailConfiguration entity to the database.
